name: gpui-ai
description: Task runner for the gpui-ai workspace. Rust does the real work; these scripts are the front door.

scripts.build:web: npm --prefix crates/gallery-web/www run build && npm run generate:posters && npm run build:site && npm run generate:og
scripts.generate: npm run generate:catalog && npm run generate:themes && npm run generate:highlight
scripts.check: npm run check:format && npm run check:clippy && npm run check:scripts && npm run test && npm run check:docs
scripts.check:scripts: node script/test-run-bash.mjs && node script/test-release-notes.mjs && node script/test-docs-cleanup.mjs
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix crates/gallery-web/www test && npm run check:site && npm run check:web:release
scripts.check:prepush: npm run check && npm run check:web
scripts.check:site: npm --prefix site run typecheck && npm --prefix site test
scripts.generate:highlight: npm run generate:build-info && npm --prefix site run generate:highlight
